MAGNET-TRAP.seoTitle: Magnetic Trap for Pfister Feeder – Cement Plant CAD Case Study
MAGNET-TRAP.seoDescription: Magnetic trap design case study for a cement plant fine coal line, focused on Pfister feeder protection, tramp metal removal, CAD drafting, and kiln downtime reduction.
MAGNET-TRAP.intro: MAGNET TRAP is a cement plant engineering case study focused on protecting the Pfister feeder from tramp metal in the fine coal line through CAD drafting, 3D modeling, and practical fabrication-ready design.
MAGNET-TRAP.heroAlt: Magnetic trap design for Pfister feeder protection in a cement plant fine coal line
